metadata.title: Dose-dense AC followed by weekly Paclitaxel
metadata.indication: Adjuvant or neoadjuvant treatment of high-risk node-negative or node-positive breast cancer.
metadata.source_title_exact: Dose-dense AC followed by weekly PACLitaxel
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

baseline: Echo or MUGA if age >65 or clinically indicated; source requires LVEF >50% for doxorubicin
Assess peripheral neuropathy as clinically indicated
Review all previous anthracyclines and cumulative-dose risk
ongoing: FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle
The service confirms blood-test timing before weekly doses
Cardiac testing (MUGA/echo/ECG) and neuropathy assessment as clinically indicated
Confirm the phase before using count, liver or supportive-care rules
source_monitoring.imaging: Anthracycline exposure and clinical risk guide monitoring. No trastuzumab is in this regimen and no routine HER2 q12-week echo schedule applies.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the official regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

output_templates.proceed: Entered values meet an encoded treatment threshold for the assessed component(s).
output_templates.delay: Entered values trigger an encoded delay threshold. Reassess according to the NCCP protocol.
output_templates.dose_reduce: An encoded dose-modification threshold is triggered. Consultant review is required.
output_templates.consultant_review: The entered result lies in a phase-dependent or non-deterministic range. Confirm the treatment phase and review the official NCCP protocol.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Return the most restrictive applicable action and display every triggered rule.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate supplied values independently. Missing values remain unassessed; never infer normality or phase.

action.recommendation: Delay AC for at least one week and confirm count recovery. Restart ANC must be >1; the printed platelet threshold is >100 after a neutropenia delay but ≥100 after a thrombocytopenia delay. After a second delay the source specifies 75%. Confirm prior delay reason, recovery and current dose before restarting.

Confirm prior delay reason, recovery and current dose before restarting.

action.recommendation: After an AC count-related delay, ANC must be strictly >1 ×10⁹/L. After prior neutropenia, the source also requires platelets >100. The separate prior-thrombocytopenia row prints platelets ≥100. Delay for the unmet threshold; confirm the delay reason and current counts.

rules.explanation: After an AC count-related delay, ANC must be strictly >1 ×10⁹/L. After prior neutropenia, the source also requires platelets >100. The separate prior-thrombocytopenia row prints platelets ≥100. Delay for the unmet threshold; confirm the delay reason and current counts.

action.recommendation: For AC restart after a count-related delay, confirm ANC >1 and both current counts. The printed platelet restart threshold is >100 after prior neutropenia but ≥100 after prior thrombocytopenia. Confirm the prior delay reason; omitted results are not presumed recovered.

rules.explanation: For AC restart after a count-related delay, confirm ANC >1 and both current counts. The printed platelet restart threshold is >100 after prior neutropenia but ≥100 after prior thrombocytopenia. Confirm the prior delay reason; omitted results are not presumed recovered.

action.recommendation: Do not give the planned doxorubicin dose if it would exceed the individual lifetime limit. NCCP lists 450 mg/m² and requires prior anthracyclines, age and cardiac risk to inform the maximum; a lower individual limit may apply.
